name: Top Smoke - Purple Punch Pre-Roll Pack
description: Purple Punch is an indica that crosses two indica-dominant classics, Larry OG and Granddaddy Purple. Smelling of grape candy, blueberry, and tart Kool-Aid, Purple Punch is a potent strain that may provide a “one-two punch” of heavy euphoria and body sedation. 28 one gram pre-rolls.
